title: agent state record body
description: An agent's state, written by the host it is placed on when the state changes.

display_name.description: The agent's name as the team knows it (the lead routes by it and the gateway's Team page shows it); not a person's name.

requests.description: The root task ids of the people's requests this agent's model turns ran for now or since its previous record, at most about 2 seconds earlier, each taken from the verified gateway-signed context of the turn's task. Ids only, never a person; readers map them only through their own request records. Absent when there are none.
